name: cc-caveman
description: Always-on caveman full mode: drops articles, filler, and tool-call narration while keeping every technical fact exact. Installing is the opt-in — a SessionStart hook injects the ruleset and a per-prompt one-liner keeps it anchored (CC_CAVEMAN_OFF=1 skips a session). Ships /caveman-compress to shrink memory files the same way. Extracted (full mode only) from JuliusBrussee/caveman, MIT.
